pipeline_version: Stage 5 V5.3 (Retention Hook & Protagonist Bootstrap Patch)

episode_1.opening_line: When the apocalypse turns Seoul into a feral meat grinder, Tae knows screaming won't save anyone.
episode_1.closing_cliffhanger: Locked eyes exchange unspoken respect—because in this new world, hesitation guarantees an instant grave.

episode_2.opening_line: Tae breaks that deadlocked gaze, calmly raising his hands as intelligence agents search him.
episode_2.closing_cliffhanger: "Back off before this gets ugly," he warns with chilling, deadpan calm.

episode_3.opening_line: Tae warned that disaster strikes unseen, beginning with a derelict vessel cutting through black waves.
episode_3.closing_cliffhanger: His fangs sink deep into a crewmate, spreading the relentless contagion instantly.

episode_4.opening_line: While that feral infection rips through the ship, Tae clings to peaceful memories before hell broke loose.
episode_4.closing_cliffhanger: Snatching a fallen guard off the ground, he hoists the body upward effortlessly.

episode_5.opening_line: Tae shines his flashlight inside the refrigerated container, expecting contraband, not an arctic meat locker.
episode_5.closing_cliffhanger: But as dozens of guttural roars echo across the district, Tae realizes this outbreak has only begun.
